title: Order of Operations
short: Multiply and divide before adding and subtracting, unless grouping says otherwise.
trouble: Children work strictly left to right, so 2 + 3 × 4 comes out as 20.

blocks.html: In multistep word problems the story told you what to do first. A bare expression like $2 + 3 \times 4$ has no story, so everyone agrees on one order. That way the same expression always has the same value.
Multiply and divide first, working from left to right. Then add and subtract, from left to right. Anything in parentheses comes before all of that.

Multiplying is a shortcut for adding equal groups: $3 \times 4$ means $4 + 4 + 4$. In $2 + 3 \times 4$, the $3 \times 4$ is one chunk, three groups of 4. Write the chunk out and you get $2 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 14$. Doing the multiplication first keeps the chunk together.

blocks.name: tapediagram
blocks.cap: $2 + 3 \times 4$ is one piece of 2 and three pieces of 4. Altogether 14.

blocks.title: Multiply before adding
steps: Look for $\times$ or $\div$. There is one: $3 \times 4 = 12$.

blocks.title: Three operations
steps: Multiplying and dividing come first. Of those two, the division is further left.

blocks.title: Left to right
steps: Multiplying and dividing are partners. Neither one always comes first: go from left to right.
blocks.a: $12$ (multiplying first would give $3$, which is not right)

blocks.html: Working straight from left to right: $2 + 3 = 5$, then $5 \times 4 = 20$. That adds the 2 into every group of 4, which the expression never asked for. Quick check: before you start, circle each $\times$ and $\div$ with the numbers on both sides. The circles are worked first.

items: Then multiply and divide, from left to right.
Then add and subtract, from left to right.
